B-COLD-RE-DERIVE.policy: re-issue session GET and discard context before every task; no retained in-session binding; memoryless-per-task

B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED.policy: as B-COLD-RE-DERIVE plus one nearest-neighbour retrieval call per task over a store of PRIOR-session receipts; retrieves a stale (foreign-session) binding for the chain task

PC-EXACT-REPLAY.policy: given the session schema and binding by construction; commits every task once with no wasted discovery

T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY.policy: one session GET per session; retain receipts; capture the one-time binding from the precursor receipt; commit each task once (chain uses the retained binding)

baselines: B-COLD-RE-DERIVE: memoryless-per-task cold re-derivation (no retained in-session binding).
B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED: prior-session receipt retrieval over raw trajectories; exact-solution retrieval with no parameterized mechanism.
PC-EXACT-REPLAY: positive control proving the substrate is not intrinsically unsatisfiable.
claim_scope_note: C-MEAS-VALID only. This experiment produces substrate-validity evidence (a pre-freeze dynamic-range certificate for a credential-free asymmetric-discovery task bank). It does not change any claim status and does not promote a mechanism. It discharges Runtime's B2 blocker or records a bounded substrate-class negative.

NC-NO-LEAK.assertion: the session binding never appears in any session/task body, any error body, or any log line; it appears only in the precursor receipt of its own session

NC-BINDING-UNIQUENESS.purpose: 48-bit session bindings are pairwise distinct over the scored matrix

NC-EMPTIED-CONTEXT.purpose: diagnostic: comparator with frozen in-session binding removed tracks the predicted comparator rate

NC-MECHANISM-OFF.purpose: sensitivity: comparator succeeds when the amortization mechanism is removed

NC-MEMORYFUL.purpose: DISCLOSED BOUNDARY DIAGNOSTIC (not a certificate input): a within-session-memoryful cold agent reaches 1.0 because it can retain the precursor binding inside the session. This is the honest amortization boundary and is reported, not hidden.

NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT.purpose: valid session token but ignores schema/receipts

NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT.expected: 1.0 at novelty 0.50 (carry distance 1), 0.875 at novelty 0.75 (carry distance 2)
NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT.purpose: amortization-boundary diagnostic: retain only the immediate predecessor receipt

counters.identification_requirement: at least 2 of 4 dimensions distinct between T and each comparator, AND success margin T-COLD >= 1/8 and T-RETRIEVAL >= 1/8 at novelty >= 0.50
counters.matched: all arms instrumented with the same four counters and accounting

decision_rule.FALSIFIES: Zero families certify AND V1-V7 pass AND NC-NO-LEAK clean AND liveness holds AND non-certification is comparator-attributable (in both families a comparator success_rate >= 0.95 at novelty >= 0.50) -> bounded substrate-class negative: credential-free asymmetric-discovery does not yield dynamic range under this construction; freeze nothing, record the negative.
decision_rule.MEASUREMENT_INVALID: Any validity gate V1-V7 fails -> infrastructure/validity failure, not a scientific result.
decision_rule.MIXED: Exactly one family certifies, or a diagnostic control is inconsistent with the non-degenerate reading (NC-MECHANISM-OFF does not flip, NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT anomalous), or liveness fails (T < 0.80 in some band, PC < 1.0), or F-LEAK fires -> diagnosis required; no unqualified certificate is issued.
decision_rule.SUPPORTS: At least one family certifies AND gates V1-V7 pass AND NC-NO-LEAK clean AND liveness holds (PC=1.0, T >= 0.80 at every band) AND the diagnostic controls are consistent with the non-degenerate reading (NC-MECHANISM-OFF -> certificate FALSE; NC-EMPTIED-CONTEXT ~ 0.875; NC-RETAIN-RECEIPT = 1.0 at 0.50 and 0.875 at 0.75; NC-NO-DISCOVERY-DIRECT 1.0 at 0.00 / 0.0 at >= 0.25) -> deliver the certified bank as a reusable substrate for B2; C-MEAS-VALID substrate-validity evidence only, no claim promotion.
decision_rule.branch_reachability: Verified at DESIGN by a rule-level classifier over synthetic worlds; see design_satisfiability_probe.output.certificate.branch_reachability (all_branches_inhabited=true). Mechanism-off independently flips the certificate to FALSE.
decision_rule.family_certifies: A family certifies iff at novelty >= 0.50 B-COLD-RE-DERIVE < 0.95 AND B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED < 0.95 AND every scored arm (T, COLD, RETRIEVAL, PC) has success_rate >= 0.80 AND matched_correctness >= 0.80 at every band (exact-match scoring) AND behavioural distinction holds (>= 2/4 counter dimensions distinct between T and each comparator AND success margins T-COLD >= 1/8 AND T-RETRIEVAL >= 1/8 at novelty >= 0.50).

design_satisfiability_probe.kind: non-outcome-bearing (construction invariants + treatment liveness on one session per arm/band + closed-form arithmetic + branch reachability). Does NOT run the scored 20-session matrix.

director_mandate_binding.allocation_question: Can a credential-free task bank engineered for ASYMMETRIC discovery - multi-task sessions in which one-time session / resource / schema discovery is amortized or cached across tasks, and therefore materially different from the bounded-negative mandatory-discovery deterministic REST class - receive a PRE-FREEZE, arithmetically checkable dynamic-range certificate (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED success_rate < 0.95 at novelty >= 0.50 on at least one family, matched correctness >= 0.80 for all arms, and a treatment/comparator distinction) so that it can serve as the reusable substrate that unblocks the flagship inheritance benchmark (B2), recording a bounded substrate-class negative and freezing nothing if the certificate is unsatisfiable on every credential-free substrate tested?
director_mandate_binding.binding_note: The Director mandate question is the binding direction (AGENTS.md precedence 5). The inherited handoff EXP-RUNTIME-37973247935 is SUPERSEDED and is used only as continuity evidence; its next_question (composite-oracle fingerprint repair) is NOT the target.

estimated_cost.notes: pure local CPU and Python stdlib; DESIGN probe already run (2 executions, byte-identical).

expected_information_gain: Decisive for the B2 blocker: it either delivers a frozen reusable substrate with an arithmetically checkable pre-freeze dynamic-range certificate, or it closes the credential-free asymmetric-discovery substrate class with a bounded negative. Both outcomes remove the current critical-path ambiguity; neither requires running the expensive C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark.
falsifier: Zero of the tested credential-free asymmetric-discovery families satisfy the certificate at novelty >= 0.50 with all validity gates V1-V7 passing: in every family a comparator success_rate >= 0.95, or comparator success is not behaviourally distinguishable from T, or matched correctness < 0.80 for some arm, or the mechanism-off control does not destroy the certificate. That is a bounded substrate-class negative: the dynamic-range prerequisite for B2 is not met by any credential-free asymmetric-discovery substrate tested.

baseline_identifiability.reason: The positive control PC-EXACT-REPLAY is 1.0 and both comparators are predicted (K-1)/K = 0.875 at novelty >= 0.50, with 3/4 (T vs COLD) and 4/4 (T vs RETRIEVAL) distinct counter dimensions; the treatment is therefore separable from each comparator by both success rate (margin 0.125 >= 1/8) and behavioural profile. The probe executed one session per arm and band and reproduced the predicted vectors exactly (T/PC 1.0; COLD/RETRIEVAL 0.875 with the predicted counters).

control_sensitivity.reason: NC-MECHANISM-OFF (removing the amortization mechanism so the binding is exposed via the session endpoint) raises cold to 1.0 and destroys the certificate (probe-verified mechanism_off_destroys_certificate=true); NC-BINDING-UNIQUENESS confirms 160/160 scored bindings distinct (probe-verified); NC-NO-LEAK is defined with a hard F-LEAK gate. The certificate is therefore sensitive to removal of the very mechanism it measures.

evidence_refs: codex/experiments/EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440 (REST-class COLD=RETRIEVAL=1.0 -> certificate FALSE on the excluded class)
decision_rule_reachability.reason: All four branches are arithmetically reachable and were verified by a rule-level classifier over synthetic worlds in design_satisfiability_probe (branch_reachability all four return their own label; all_branches_inhabited=true). SUPPORTS: predicted certifying world (comparators 0.875 in [0.80,0.95), T/PC 1.0, matched correctness >= 0.875 every arm, 3/4 and 4/4 counter distinctness, margin 0.125 >= 1/8). FALSIFIES: a ceiling world with comparators at 1.0 returns FALSIFIES (not MIXED) because comparator rates are measured outputs, not equality-frozen; independently NC-MECHANISM-OFF drives cold to 1.0 -> certificate FALSE (probe-verified). MIXED: F-LEAK firing, exactly one family certifying, or liveness failure. MEASUREMENT_INVALID: any V1-V7 failure.

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: There is no pre-existing mutable local code, data, task bank or fixture that this experiment's interpretation depends on: the substrate is generated entirely from the frozen literals in spec.json (class_id, derivations, endpoints, arms, controls, certificate) with stdlib only and no external dataset, credential or repository file. The EXECUTE-authored harness does not exist at freeze time and is bound instead by the V1 code-fidelity manifest (sha256 of every authored file + python3 --version) recorded in result.json.artifacts. Accordingly freeze_artifacts is empty, as the freezer requires for NOT_APPLICABLE.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Every hard prerequisite is present now. python 3.12.15 is installed; stdlib http.server/http.client/urllib.request/hashlib/json/threading import and a live in-process stdlib HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 answered the session request (probe transport_stdlib_http=true). All 7 protocol invariants hold on the in-process model (session never reveals binding; chain resource null; precursor reveals binding once; precursor re-commit 409 with no re-reveal; wrong/foreign binding 400 with no leak; correct binding 200; binding consumed on reuse). server_secret is deterministic from run_seed. No credentials, browser, dataset, external endpoint or model access is required. The only EXECUTE-added item is a full-surface transport conformance gate (V2), which is a verification step, not a missing prerequisite.

treatment_liveness.reason: T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY completed a full session at every novelty band in the probe (8/8 at 0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75; treatment_live_all_novelties=true) and PC-EXACT-REPLAY completed 8/8 at every band; defect_sessions=0. The treatment executes end-to-end on the credential-free substrate.

hypothesis: At least one credential-free asymmetric-discovery family (class SBA-CREDENTIAL-FREE-V1) yields, at novelty >= 0.50, B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED success_rate below the 0.95 ceiling - specifically the closed form (K-1)/K = 0.875 for K=8, because exactly one of K tasks per session (the chain task) is satisfiable only via the one-time session binding - while every scored arm retains matched correctness >= 0.80 and the treatment T-AMORTIZED-DISCOVERY is behaviourally and arithmetically distinct from both comparators. If so the family is dynamic-range certified pre-freeze and can serve as the reusable B2 substrate.

legacy_comparative_reasoning.differences_from_pre2: Pre-2.0 runtime work concerned substrate demand and maintenance economics, not task-bank dynamic range. The ceiling-degeneracy certificate is new Research-2.0 control-plane work.
legacy_comparative_reasoning.pre2_classification: NO_MATCH for a pre-freeze dynamic-range certificate
legacy_comparative_reasoning.pre2_guard: P2-WP003 leakage precedent is the binding guard: the one-time session binding must never be readable outside its single intended reveal (V3 / NC-NO-LEAK).

pre_freeze_arithmetic_certificate.comparator_rate_closed_form: (K-1)/K, because exactly one of K tasks per session (the chain task) is satisfiable only via the one-time session binding
pre_freeze_arithmetic_certificate.distinctness: T vs COLD differ in 3/4 counter dimensions, T vs RETRIEVAL in 4/4 (probe-verified)

product_consequence_negative: If no tested credential-free asymmetric-discovery family certifies with all gates passing, Runtime records a bounded substrate-class negative: the B2 dynamic-range prerequisite is not satisfied by this class, no substrate is frozen, and the director must choose a different level of description (e.g. a non-credential-free or economically-bearing carrier) rather than re-discover the ceiling once more. This is a first-class negative, not an infrastructure failure.
product_consequence_positive: If >= 1 credential-free asymmetric-discovery family certifies pre-freeze, Runtime has a reusable B2 substrate where cold re-derivation and retrieval-shaped comparators are not at ceiling; the flagship four-arm inheritance benchmark (COLD vs INSTRUCTIONS vs RETRIEVAL vs SPIDER) becomes fundable because any SPIDER success or cost advantage now has measurable dynamic range. C-MEAS-VALID gains substrate-validity evidence only; no mechanism promotion.
question: Can a credential-free task bank engineered for ASYMMETRIC discovery - multi-task sessions in which one-time session / resource / schema discovery is amortized or cached across tasks, and therefore materially different from the bounded-negative mandatory-discovery deterministic REST class - receive a PRE-FREEZE, arithmetically checkable dynamic-range certificate (B-COLD-RE-DERIVE and B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED success_rate < 0.95 at novelty >= 0.50 on at least one family, matched correctness >= 0.80 for all arms, and a treatment/comparator distinction) so that it can serve as the reusable substrate that unblocks the flagship inheritance benchmark (B2), recording a bounded substrate-class negative and freezing nothing if the certificate is unsatisfiable on every credential-free substrate tested?

commit_semantics.chain: requires resource_id == current session binding; binding consumed on first success; reuse -> 400; wrong/foreign -> 400 with no binding echoed
commit_semantics.precursor: first success reveals binding in receipt; re-commit -> 409 with NO re-reveal
commit_semantics.requires: valid session_token; schema_epoch must match when requires_schema; resource_id must equal the expected resource for the task

derivation.randomness: none; server_secret is deterministic (no `secrets`, no clock, no os.urandom)

substrate.description: Session-Binding-Amortized: credential-free, stdlib-only, deterministic multi-task HTTP sessions in which a one-time 48-bit session binding is discovered exactly once inside a precursor task receipt and amortized across the remainder of the session. This is materially different from the bounded-negative mandatory-discovery deterministic REST class (EXP-PRODUCT-37989728440), whose comparators sat at 1.0.
endpoints: GET  /api/v1/{family}/session            -> 200 {session_token, schema_epoch, epoch}; never contains the binding
GET  /api/v1/{family}/task/{i}           -> 200 {index, requires_schema, resource_id, is_chain}; chain task resource_id null

task_layout.chain_task: resource_id is null on GET; only the current session's binding satisfies commit
task_layout.precursor_task: its first successful commit receipt carries chain_resource_id = binding exactly once

substrate.transport: stdlib http.server.ThreadingHTTPServer on 127.0.0.1 ephemeral port; stdlib urllib.request client
